# Native Quick Look

This synthetic document is the visual reference for **Markdown previews**.
The window, title bar, controls, background, and scrolling belong to macOS.

## Readable text

Select and copy this paragraph. Resize the preview window and dismiss it
with Space or Escape. Unicode stays intact: café, 日本語, مرحباً, 🌿.

- One item
- Another item with *emphasis*
  - Nested detail
- [x] Completed task
- [ ] Remaining task

> No original user documents are used for this comparison.

| Feature | Behavior |
| :--- | :--- |
| Text | Select and copy |
| Resources | Local only |

```swift
let preview = "Native Markdown"
if preview.isEmpty {
    return
}
```
